chapter.heading: Pray for All Men
chapter.v:
Therefore I
exhort first of all that supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks be made for all men, [Num. 12:6, 8;]

for kings
and all who are in authority, that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and reverence.

For this
is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior, [John 1:14]

who desires
all men to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth. [Is. 9:6, 7; Luke]

For there
is one God and one Mediator between God and men, the Man Christ Jesus, [Ps. 2:7; Acts]

who gave
Himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time, [Ps. 89:27; [Rom.]

for which
I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am speaking the truth in Christ and not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.Men and Women in the Church [Ps. 104:4]

in like
manner also, that the women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with propriety and moderation, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or costly clothing, [Is. 61:1, 3 #]

but, which
is proper for women professing godliness, with good works. [Ps. 102:25-27]

Let a
woman learn in silence with all submission. [[Is. 34:4] q Is.]

And I
do not permit a woman to teach or to have authority over a man, but to be in silence. [Heb. 13:8]

For Adam
was formed first, then Eve. [Ps. 110:1;]

And Adam
was not deceived, but the woman being deceived, fell into transgression. [Ps. 103:20;]

Nevertheless she
will be saved in childbearing if they continue in faith, love, and holiness, with self-control.
